expectations.text: States the capture posture explicitly as recorded for later, not streamed, before recommending any equipment
expectations.evidence: Assumption 1: "Capture posture: recorded for later, no live stream." It comes before the equipment sections.

expectations.text: Chooses a coverage tier per room separately rather than applying one tier to the whole event
expectations.evidence: Tier table: Room A is a fixed camera on the board feed; Room B is a fixed camera plus a lavalier into a standalone recorder.

expectations.text: Specifies that the Room A recording takes its audio feed from the mixing board rather than from a camera's built-in microphone
expectations.evidence: "the archive audio comes from the desk in Room A... It never comes from the camcorder's microphone."

expectations.text: Treats Room B's absence of a sound system as a problem for the recording's audio rather than assuming camera audio is acceptable there
expectations.evidence: "There is no board, so the microphone and recorder are the board."

expectations.text: Recommends a fixed camera taking the board feed as the default tier for at least one room rather than starting at multi-camera coverage
expectations.evidence: Room A: "Fixed camera on the board feed."

expectations.text: Describes a signal path with three destinations off one signal: the room's display, the recording or encoder path, and a monitor the crew watches
expectations.evidence: The audio path splits only to the PA and the recorder. For slides the diagram shows projector and USB capture, with the capture laptop's screen as the monitor. There is no clear three-way split.

expectations.text: Identifies the crew monitor as the destination that catches a failure nobody would otherwise notice until editing
expectations.evidence: "The recording was silently black or silent for 40 minutes" is protected by the crew monitor, checked at the start of every talk.

expectations.text: Names a single production owner and states that this person is not simultaneously MCing, speaking or running registration
expectations.evidence: "Production owner... Not an MC, a speaker or registration."

expectations.text: Recommends the full introduction level of crew training rather than a brief refresher, on the grounds that this is a first edition with no experienced crew
expectations.evidence: "the full introduction training applies. The shorter refresher is for returning crews".

expectations.text: Requires one test recording to be played back in full before the first session and distinguishes that from watching a level meter
expectations.evidence: "Record 60 seconds and play it back in full. A moving level meter is not proof."
